answer: Split the network by a ridge into two watersheds, and pay only for work endorsed from across it: an identity's output earns only when strangers on the far side of the ridge vouch for it live. Each voucher spends one yarrow token that regrows slowly, one per epoch, and is stamped umber once used so it can never be spent twice. Clones clustered on one side cannot vouch for each other across the ridge, and a farm must cultivate real cross-ridge supporters per clone, each limited by slow token regrowth, so multiplying accounts multiplies scarce endorsements needed without multiplying payout.
